Evidence & scope

This existing independently source-qualified family now has separate actual author, source-verifier and adversarial reviews of complete pinned creator-card text and exact substantive provenance, workflow, schema, access/rights declarations and limitations. The inspected README revision is documentation identity, not a verified download/recount or immutable inventory of the dataset payload. Configurations, stages, models and regenerated traces do not add families. No paper/code/media/payload, experimental performance, upstream-rights clearance or operational execution audit is represented. Original unsuccessful hypotheses and real negative reviews remain candidates.

AM-DeepSeek-R1-Distilled · documents: The AM card describes about 1.4 million Chinese-and-English reasoning entries: about 0.5 million reused from open datasets and about 0.9 million DeepSeek-R1-671B response generations attributed to the AM team.

candidate.distill5.am.mixed-response-origins.v1

  • These are creator release-scale descriptions, not independently recounted payload totals; the source tables are non-exhaustive.
  • The reused and AM-generated components have different response provenance, and the limitations warn of inaccurate attribution caused by nested source relationships.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

AM-DeepSeek-R1-Distilled · has stage: AM processing describes rule- and LLM-based reference-answer checks for part of the data, sandbox verification for code with test cases, and reward-model scoring followed by rejection sampling.

candidate.distill5.am.partial-verification-conflict.v1

  • The introduction says all responses underwent rigorous verification, but the limitations say the LLM-generated dataset was not strictly verified and retains factuality shortcomings; both statements remain explicit.
  • Reference answers and test cases are documented only for some records; the schema does not establish universal answer-check or executable-test coverage.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

AM-DeepSeek-R1-Distilled · documents: AM records are documented as user/assistant messages with role, content and info; assistant content separates reasoning and answers, and info can retain source, reference answers, test cases and separate reasoning/answer content.

candidate.distill5.am.record-source-and-trace-format.v1

  • The illustrated user source is natural_reasoning and assistant source am-0309, an example of distinct prompt/response provenance rather than a corpus census.
  • The header represents test_case as a struct but the loading example declares a string; this mismatch is retained without claiming executable parser compatibility.
  • Reference answers and code test cases apply only to some problems, and nested attribution may be inaccurate.
